Car was speeding that killed four on Linden Highway

Oct 25, 2026 News

…three others remain critical following Friday night’s smash-up

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:19
Instaread

(Kaieteur News) – Police have reported that the car involved in Friday night’s fatal collision on the Linden-Soesdyke Highway was travelling at a fast rate of speed before crashing into the rear of a fuel truck owned by the Guyana Defence Force (GDF).

The collision, which occurred around 20:45 hrs in the vicinity of Long Creek, claimed the lives of four of the car’s seven occupants, while the three survivors remain in critical condition.

The dead have been identified as Egburt Blair, 55, also known as “Glasses”, of Half Mile, Wismar, Linden; Tevin Thompson, 30, of One Mile, Wismar, Linden; Dannel Darrell, 28, of Block 22, Wismar, Linden; and Eon Jarvis, 40, of Wismar, Linden.

Tevin Thompson

Dannel Darrell

Egburt Blair

Eon Jarvis

According to police reports, motor lorry #DFB 1788, owned by the GDF and driven by a 40-year-old resident of Paradise Village, West Coast Berbice, was proceeding south along the eastern driving lane when motorcar #PZZ 8392 approached from behind.

The car, driven by Blair and carrying six other occupants, was reportedly travelling at a fast rate of speed when Blair lost control and crashed into the rear of the heavy-duty fuel truck. The impact left the car mangled, trapping several of its occupants inside.

Emergency responders from the Guyana Fire Service and police ranks rushed to the scene. Firefighters used specialised extrication equipment to cut through the wreckage and remove the trapped victims. All seven occupants were transported to the Linden Hospital Complex, where Blair, Thompson, Darrell and Jarvis were examined by medical personnel and pronounced dead on arrival.

The three surviving passengers sustained severe, life-threatening injuries and were stabilised before being admitted to the hospital’s Accident and Emergency Unit for further treatment.

They are a 43-year-old woman of Rainbow City, Mackenzie, Linden; a 45-year-old man of Block 22, Wismar, Linden; and a 40-year-old man of Green Valley, Wismar, Linden. Police investigations into the fatal collision are ongoing.
